title: The Same House…
content: Hi there. I’ve been dreaming about the same house for years. Sometimes it’s my ideal dream home - everything bright, shiny, clean… sometimes it’s dark, cluttered, falling apart. I can close my eyes and see the layout! Somehow it’s a walkout lower level into a multicar garage… always a main floor with like.. a ballroom and tons of folding chairs. Up a large and semi-winding staircase - 3 huge bedrooms on that level all with en-suite baths. Continuing up the staircase and there is a third floor with JUST my room on it. I’ve painted it. I’ve had friends over to it. I’ve had baths in the tub. Seriously, it borderline creeps me out/makes me feel comfy!
